scope: Q3 input and actual AI reply attribution/range validation; no semantic judgment, rendering, media observation or external transmission.

initialFailureAttribution.singleCause: The existing strict JSON decoder returns null-prototype objects. The test compared their JavaScript prototypes with regular fixture objects using deepStrictEqual, despite all decoded JSON values being equal.
initialFailureAttribution.correction: Compare a structured clone of the decoded result with the fixture. The decoder, received bytes and returned JSON values were not changed.
initialFailureAttribution.preservedEvidence: The first TAP and empty stderr remain saved. Later clock/coverage additions are new boundary checks, not fixes hidden by changing expected JSON values.

verifiedBoundaries: Exact input/reply/unit/evidence/candidate keys; known unique identifiers and complete processed-target coverage.
Input canonical identity and completed-media identity; raw response byte hash independent of whitespace.
Whole-video partition by caption and no-caption intervals; related evidence references and bounds.
Exact recomputation of final/baseline/original source parts from the saved clock; inserted intervals retain null origins.
Audio sample count covers video duration while permitting AAC decoder tail samples.
Historical audio evidence is split into retained spans and cannot cover inserted silence.
Candidate ranges overlap each nominated unit and evidence and are covered by the nominated unit union.
Natural-language fact attribution requires an included evidence ID; observation content itself is not machine-certified.
Complete with zero candidates is accepted; incomplete/failed preserve partial work and never enable review.
Raw strict JSON rejects duplicate keys, fractional ranges, code fences, trailing values, BOM and invalid UTF-8.
Streaming file identity and SHA verification detects missing/changed references without modifying sources.
limits: Small synthetic packet fixtures were used. The actual HRB001 run is recorded by the integration owner.
Validation proves packet/reference/range consistency, not the truth of natural-language observations, hypotheses or human quality.
Media decoding, original projection creation and evidence measurement belong to the input preparer; this validator does not re-run them.
No changes to selectors, renderers or the fixed Q2 review schema; no API/new dependencies/new media.
